run_watermark_0bit: run the 0-bit watermarking pipeline to embed watermarks in images from a data directory
run_decode_watermarks: run the decode only mode to detect watermarks in images from a folder
run_evaluate_watermarks: run the watermark evaluation pipeline to test robustness against various image attacks
build_argparse_parser: build an argparse parser with experiment marking neural network and optimization parameters
run_main_pipeline: run the main function to watermark images with a target PSNR and false positive rate
